content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident (M.B.B.S): MBBS Degree from MCI recognized university with internship completion certificate. Candidates who have completed Internship within the period of 20/08/2024 to 19/08/2026 are eligible. Registration with Delhi Medical Council is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BMH Delhi Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital (BMH Delhi) is conducting the recruitment drive for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) positions. It's a government job opportunity in Delhi for eligible medical professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Resident (M.B.B.S). This is an ad-hoc job type, providing a valuable opportunity for fresh medical graduates to gain experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts at Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital. Interested candidates should check the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for BMH Delhi Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is "Walk-in". Candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts is scheduled for 20 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from an MCI recognized university with an internship completion certificate and compulsory registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) at BMH Delhi?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital Junior Resident recruitment. It's a free application process.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Junior Resident (M.B.B.S) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by document verification. Candidates must ensure they bring all original and self-attested copies of required documents.
